rule_mapping: S = C2 watch rule on the card's test rows. consumed = 1: bounce with probability sigmoid(bounce_bias + bounce_affinity*aff), bounce time uniform on (1, 6) s, else T ~ Exponential(rate lam), lam = hazard_per_s * exp(hazard_affinity*aff + hazard_familiar*fam + hazard_sat*(sat - 0.5) + hazard_seen*seen), sat = 0.5, T truncated at the duration; consumed = 0: the simulator records watch 0 for a skip, so the predictive distribution is a point mass at 0. Predictive quantiles of log1p(T) at the card's levels computed by Monte Carlo (2,000 draws per row, seed 0). aff, fam, seen as content_consumption. SF: exponential-hazard rate refitted (one log-linear regression of log1p(play_s) on the same inputs) - reported only

extra.long_horizon_kind: static: mean over test days of |80% interval coverage - 0.8|
extra.S_quantiles: exact quantiles of the C2 mixture by bisection (instead of the plan's 2,000-draw Monte Carlo; same estimand without sampling error)
